summary: Read-only prompt echo so committed command history keeps the segmented starship-style prompt chrome
expected: Terminal transcripts can render recorded commands with the same lead dots, host/path segments, rounded caps and bold symbol as the live prompt, without an input element
acceptanceCriteria: Vue and React expose a read-only echo using existing terminal segment tones and tokens; no second prompt implementation or consumer-side material
XCA transcript history lines render user@host and directory segments identical to the live prompt in both themes and widths
Existing selection, follow-tail and accessibility behavior of the transcript is unchanged; snapshot baselines re-verified

consumers.scenario: Command history entries in the terminal transcript

resolution: Delivered UiTerminalEcho in Vue/React using shared internal prompt segment renderers, existing terminal tones/tokens and no editor/tabstop; public exports, framework parity, matrix, Design Lab and docs/terminal-composition.md updated. XCA-Portal app/features/terminal/components/TerminalTranscript.vue consumes recorded identity/directory/status; TerminalHost.vue preserves mouse text selection. Evidence: Vue suite 75 passed; React suite 38 passed; terminal-composition, terminal-surface, terminal-resize, terminal-theme-contract and react-parity Playwright scenarios 50 passed on Windows and 50 passed under native Linux/WSL in non-update mode. Platform-specific Vue/React light/dark 480/1440 snapshots reviewed; XCA terminal-shared-ui, terminal-visual-acceptance and terminal-completion scenarios 17 passed in non-update mode, including 390/1440 widths and five refreshed Windows baselines. Changed package typechecks, XCA build/typecheck/terminal boundary, check:contracts, text integrity, changed-file Biome/Stylelint and eight-package public API verification passed (XCA Biome reports two existing informational nextTick callback diagnostics). Browser smoke exercised Vue/React and real XCA command submission. Consumer Validation retained; React real-product consumption pending. No commit or publication.
